slides.teacher_cue: Two new r-controlled vowels today. air = /eə/ — a diphthong that starts at /e/ and glides toward a schwa: fair, hair, pair, chair. ear/eer = /ɪə/ — a diphthong that starts at /ɪ/ and glides toward a schwa: ear, hear, near, fear, deer, cheer. Both are r-influenced diphthongs. Group 6 is complete after this lesson — all four r-controlled vowels now taught.
slides.expected_response: Students produce both /eə/ and /ɪə/ cleanly and distinguish the two r-controlled diphthongs.
slides.correction_move: Model the contrast: fair /eə/ vs fear /ɪə/. Students alternate. Then establish the three spellings: air, ear, eer — and the sounds they make.
slides.observation_note: Watch for confusion between the two sounds — both are r-influenced diphthongs but start at different heights.

slides.teacher_cue: Say air — the atmosphere. air on its own. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say air orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model air orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for the /eə/ diphthong — starts at /e/, glides toward schwa.

slides.teacher_cue: Say fair — just and equal; also an outdoor event. Confirm /f/ onset and air vowel. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say fair orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model fair orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /p/ on /f/ and /eə/ diphthong.

slides.teacher_cue: Point to a chair. ch onset, air vowel. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say chair orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model chair orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /tʃ/ onset and /eə/ diphthong.

slides.teacher_cue: Point to an ear. ear on its own. Reveal and blend. Contrast with air — different starting vowel.
slides.expected_response: Students say ear orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model ear orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /ɪə/ — starts higher than /eə/. Compare fair vs fear.

slides.teacher_cue: Say hear — to perceive sound. ear vowel. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say hear orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model hear orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /ɪə/ in ear and clear /h/ onset.

slides.teacher_cue: Mime cheering. ch onset, eer spelling this time. Same /ɪə/ sound. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say cheer orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model cheer orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /tʃ/ onset and the eer spelling — same sound as ear.
